correctness.rationale: Direct stationary balance gives h_beta(c). Symbolic differentiation yields the exact N_beta numerator and its explicitly strictly negative derivative on every interior p for beta>=2. Opposite endpoint signs establish exactly one root. Conditional binomial centered moments and bounded interior derivatives give the pointwise O(g^-2) correction. At t=log beta-log log beta+a, normalized N converges to 1-exp(-a), and strict root uniqueness brackets the asymptotic. Exact symbolic and rational checks in VERIFY.py reproduce the derivations; they are not substituted for proof.

value.rationale: The stationary high-resource fraction is a direct quantitative mechanism behind feedback game transitions. Its Jensen/finite-hyperedge correction can favor or disfavor high states depending on underlying cooperation, so a unique exact sign boundary matters for mean-field approximations. The log-log location shows that nonlinear recovery sensitivity pushes the crossover into a shrinking near-unanimity regime. This gives a parameter-wide structural classification, not a selected numerical slice or a restatement of a standard expansion.
